text: Lawmakers are demanding answers from the U.S. Navy amid reports of a mental health crisis, including multiple attempted suicides, onboard the USS Abraham Lincoln (CVN-72) currently deployed to the Middle East to support military operations and the ongoing naval blockade against Iran.  Sen. Richard Blumenthal (D-Conn.), a member of the Senate Armed Services Committee, wrote a letter to Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth and Acting Navy Secretary Hung Cao on Wednesday to express “serious concern” about reports involving a shortages of “basic supplies, water contamination, plumbing issues, deteriorating mental health, deck safety concerns” onboard the Lincoln.   According to reports from the Navy Times and Stars and Stripes, citing family members and spouses of Sailors assigned to the Lincoln, people aboard the ship are suffering from exhaustion, suicidal thoughts and low morale, with some alleging that Sailors have made multiple attempts to jump overboard requiring intervention from other Servicemembers.  Amid the wave of concerning reports from the Lincoln, Navy leadership met with the family of Sailors who are deployed aboard the Abraham Lincoln on Thursday in San Diego, listening to concerns and stories while pledging to support those onboard, according to Stars and Stripes.

text: From arriving in Russia to dying on the Donbas battlefield in roughly six weeks.  Ukraine’s military intelligence identified Filipino national Jeric Jumadil Undol, who signed a contract with Russia on May 3 after arriving in April. After only about a week of training, he was sent to the front and killed in late May during an assault in Ukraine’s Donetsk Oblast.  His case reflects a broader Russian system that recruits foreigners from around the world with promises of money and other incentives, then rapidly sends many into high-risk combat. At least 27,000 foreign nationals from more than 130 countries have joined Russia’s military since 2022, according to a recent report.  🔗Read more: https://euromaidanpress.com/2026/05/19/who-are-the-foreign-fighters-in-russias-army/   📷Ukraine’s Main Directorate of Intelligence
